thesis: Jared Kushner argues that setbacks and failures are training opportunities that teach valuable lessons rather than reasons for fear or anger. He illustrates this mindset by describing his 2007 investment in 666 Fifth Avenue, which he characterized as having a correct thesis but incorrect timing and capital structure due to the impending market crash.
